=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:5040-5263 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The G4 source-issue guard (`_merge_lease_not_planned_source_prs`) runs only in the merge-train ticks (review_merge_train.sh:2343-2347, 2715-2718). The update-mode free-lease paths in `_merge_lease_gate` and `_merge_lease_gate_multi` still grant the lease to the first queued PR without checking whether its `ai/issue-<n>` source issue was closed as not_planned.
  WHY: The tick unlabels the orphan, the review sweep dispatches it again and relabels it, and the update-mode gate then acquires the free lease for it (outcome=acquired). G4 forbids that grant, and the orphan spends a review run every tick. All reviewers who raised it rated it MAJOR (mapped to high).
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:903-990 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: An own PR whose head-gate cannot be read is recorded as `head_gate: "unknown"` (commit oid differs from headRefOid, or the status is unreadable). `own_pr_guard` does not refuse it, and `_own_pr_retire_ops` comments "Superseded" on it and closes it. `test_reissue_with_a_non_green_own_pr_retires_it` locks this behaviour in.
  WHY: G2 says a failed or unknown read refuses, and a PR may be closed only when it is known not to be green, so a possibly green PR gets closed and duplicated. Severities disagree: sonnet said NIT, the other four said MAJOR; the highest (MAJOR, mapped to high) is used.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1641-1840 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan orders the ops as create_issue, close(item), the "Superseded by" comment, then close(own PR) (scripts/unblock_actions.py:1667-1671, 1721-1723). A failed retire comment sets `ops_failed="true"`, so the own-PR close is skipped as `prerequisite_failed`, and any mixed-route heal_report is skipped as `earlier_op_failed`.
  WHY: By then the replacement issue exists and the source issue is closed, but the old PR stays open and keeps running review and CI, which is what G3 is meant to prevent. The verdict marker is already written, so the run never retries. All reviewers who raised it rated it MAJOR (mapped to high).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3478-3485 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_merge_lease_not_planned_source_prs`, `gh_retry` drops the stdout of a failed attempt, and `gh api graphql` exits non-zero on any `errors` (including a partial one-alias error). `lease_out` is then empty, `jq` on empty input exits 0, and the `outcome=unavailable reason=source_issue_read_failed` branch never runs.
  WHY: One unresolvable alias, or a full read failure, silently turns the G4 guard off for every waiter on that base with no log line. This contradicts the code comment and the README, agents.d and changelog promises. Severities disagree: luna said NIT, the other four said MAJOR; the highest (MAJOR, mapped to high) is used.
- .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml:194-199 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `own_prs_from_graphql` (scripts/unblock_actions.py:869) reads `MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL`, but the unblock judge workflow env does not export it, so the parser falls back to `ai:merge-lease-wait`.
  WHY: In a consumer with a custom wait label, a lease-waiting PR reports `lease_wait: false`, the `own_pr_lease_wait` refusal never fires, and `_own_pr_retire_ops` closes the PR, which G2 forbids. Severities disagree: sonnet said NIT, the others MAJOR; the highest (MAJOR, mapped to high) is used. Scope also disagrees: gemini, minimax and luna say orchestrate_poll.yml:1693/1938 is affected too, while sonnet and glm say the orchestrate_poll unblock steps already export it (lines 1638/1905) and only unblock_judge.yml lacks it.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2359-2665 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `unblock_resolve_own_prs` reads the own-PR facts (head-gate, lease-wait label) once, before the judge model call. The re-issue guard and the retire comment/close then act on that snapshot without reading it again before actuation.
  WHY: An own PR that turns green or gains the lease-wait label during the minutes-long model call is still closed as "Superseded", and there is no re-verify step like the block-state recheck at lines 3342-3344. All flagging reviewers said MAJOR (mapped to high). Sonnet dropped this item on purpose: G1 reads the facts once by design, and it found no concrete failing path.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:241 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `OWN_PR_GUARD_REASONS` is defined but never used. The same three reason strings are hard-coded in `own_pr_guard` and again in scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2452-2454.
  WHY: A typo or rename in one place would not be caught. This is a maintenance hazard only (NIT, mapped to low).
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:986-989 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: If `create_issue` returns a non-integer `created` value, the retire comment is skipped with `reason=no_created_issue`, and the own-PR close is then skipped through `ops_failed`. Nothing recovers from that state.
  WHY: The source issue is closed and the new issue created, but the old PR is neither commented nor closed. The reviewer notes the structural cause is the comment/close coupling (NIT, mapped to low).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "G4. The lease does not serve an orphan. The merge-lease grant skips a pull request whose head ref is ai/issue-<n> when issue <n> is closed with state reason not_planned" (Approach step 3: "scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh: add the G4 skip where lease candidates are filtered")
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_merge_lease_gate()` and `_merge_lease_gate_multi()` update-mode grant paths
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `_merge_lease_not_planned_source_prs` is called only from `_mt_merge_lease_tick` / `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` (review_merge_train.sh:2343-2347, 2715-2718); `_merge_lease_gate` goes from queue selection to writing the lease (lines 5205-5263) and `_merge_lease_gate_multi` joins the lease (lines 5038-5096) without a source-issue check; tests/test_merge_lease.py LeaseSourceIssueGuard covers only the tick (_p2_tick), not update-mode acquisition.
- requirement: "When the unblock judge re-issues a standalone issue, ... a re-issue closes the old pull request." (G3)
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The retire comment and the PR close run in one sequential op list without checking that the earlier op succeeded; if the comment fails, the close is skipped and the PR stays open in a superseded state.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_gate, update-mode free-lease branch, lines 5205-5263 (lease_first="$(_merge_lease_queue_first ...)" followed by _merge_lease_write ... held, outcome=acquired); _merge_lease_gate_multi around line 5052. The only callers of _merge_lease_not_planned_source_prs are in scripts/review_merge_train.sh at lines 2343-2347 and 2715-2718. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The G4 check runs only in the merge-train ticks. The update-mode gate gives a free lease to the first queued PR, or to the caller when the listing cannot be read, without checking for a not_planned source issue.
  WHY: The tick unlabels the orphan (review_merge_train.sh:2452), the sweep dispatches it again (review_merge_train.sh:2466-2469), and the gate acquires for it (outcome=acquired at line 5258). The orphan loops through unlabel, review and relabel every tick. Suggested fix: apply the skip using lease_pulls_json, with no new read per PR.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:own_prs_from_graphql (commit.get("oid") != head_sha sets head_gate = ci_final = "unknown"; _own_pr_status_state returns "unknown" for an unrecognised state), together with own_pr_guard (green = head_gate == "success") and _own_pr_retire_ops (skips only head_gate == "success" or lease_wait) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A PR with head_gate "unknown" counts as not green and is closed as superseded. test_reissue_with_a_non_green_own_pr_retires_it locks this in.
  WHY: This violates the fail-closed rule: a PR whose status could not be read is closed and duplicated instead of refused. The trigger is rare. Suggested fix: treat "unknown" as own_pr_unknown in own_pr_guard, or skip it in _own_pr_retire_ops.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh, with scripts/unblock_actions.py:unblock_actions.py plan(), lines 1667-1671 and 1721-1723 (op order: create_issue, close item, Superseded comment, PR close, then the _mixed_heal_ops heal_report); unblock_judge.sh unblock_run_ops lines 1671-1673 (a failed comment sets ops_failed="true"), lines 1828-1831 (close skipped with reason=prerequisite_failed when ops_failed) and lines 1641-1656 (heal_report skipped with earlier_op_failed) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If only the retire comment POST fails, ops_failed is set, the PR close is skipped as prerequisite_failed, and the mixed-route heal_report is skipped as earlier_op_failed.
  WHY: The replacement exists and the source is closed, but the old PR stays open and keeps running review and CI (G3). The round marker is already written, so there is no retry. Suggested fix: emit the close before the created_ref comment, or stop the comment failure from setting ops_failed.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_not_planned_source_prs, lease_out="$(gh_retry gh api graphql ... 2>/dev/null)" || true, followed by the jq check of '.data.repository | if type == "object" then . else error("no repository") end ...' on "${lease_out}" | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: gh_retry (scripts/gh_helpers.sh:3003-3006, 3082-3086) drops failed stdout. `gh api graphql` exits non-zero on `errors`, so lease_out is empty, jq exits 0, and the source_issue_read_failed branch never runs.
  WHY: One unresolvable alias, or a full read failure, silently disables the guard with no log line, despite the README, agents.d and changelog promises. Suggested fix: use plain `gh api graphql ... || true` and treat an empty response or a missing `.data.repository` as source_issue_read_failed.
- .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml:step env around line 194-197 (UNBLOCK_REISSUE_OWN_PR_GUARD_ENABLED was added, MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL is absent; grep finds no MERGE_LEASE entries in the file); scripts/unblock_actions.py own_prs_from_graphql: wait_label = env.get("MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL") or "ai:merge-lease-wait" | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: unblock_judge.yml, which runs scripts/unblock_judge.sh (line 229), does not export MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL. The orchestrate_poll.yml steps do export it.
  WHY: With a custom label, a waiter reports lease_wait=false, the own_pr_lease_wait refusal never fires, and _own_pr_retire_ops closes the PR. Suggested fix: add MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL: ${{ vars.MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL || 'ai:merge-lease-wait' }}.
